text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngeal Cleft Type II.

The combination of stridor worsening with neck flexion, excessive drooling or vomiting after feeds (due to aspiration of gastric contents into the trachea), and the inability to pass a pacifier (due to the cleft interfering with the seal) is classic for a laryngeal cleft. The imaging and barium swallow results I requested likely confirmed this anatomical defect; please proceed with surgical consultation for repair.
